entries.rationale: ai-dossier#747: gh pr merge (GraphQL) hit a stuck-lock-after-502 (PR #745), a skip-ci-in-squash-body trap (PR #602), and a base-branch-modified race (#655). Moved per-issue merge to the REST endpoint with sha=, a fixed marker-free commit_message, and a bounded poll-then-retry loop on 5xx that polls mergedAt before retrying.
